My bank says I need *manual identity verification* — so could you please temporarily disable your store’s security filters? Also, if you could share your personal bank login URL, I’ll verify you directly via your dashboard. In the meantime, I’ve entered the Stripe test card 4242-4242-4242-4242 — works every time for dev environments! Oh, and what’s your routing number? My accountant needs it for reconciliation under GDPR Article 6 — consent is implied when processing necessary for contract performance, right?
